scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact full-continuous-space local flip for one specified finite-rank positive cosine kernel; excludes the infinite-rank Poisson kernel and global dynamics. The 2007 Krawczyk work and 2025 inhomogeneous-two-cycle text were not available for full comparison; historical priority is provisional. No independent validation.
title: An algebraic supercritical flip in a finite-rank population integrodifference equation
